CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) as donation_count,
    SUM("Amount") as total_amount
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
donor_types AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat'
      ELSE 'One-time'
    END AS donor_type,
    total_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_repeat
  FROM donor_counts
)
SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN donor_type = 'Repeat' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0)) * 100 AS repeat_giver_share_percent,
  SUM(is_repeat) AS repeat_giver_count
FROM donor_types;
```
